score_method: 7 graded events, weights 7 (Feb 2025) down to 1 (Mar 2021). Weighted sum 28.0 / weight sum 28 x 5 = 5.0. The Aug 2026 call is pending and excluded.
coverage_notes: No transcript was found on the company IR page between Feb 2025 and Aug 2026 (not_retrieved). The Q4 FY25 to Q4 FY26 calls are missing.
The 1 Oct 2020 call is outside the 8-event window. No promise from it was traced under Rule 7.
Promises with an unexpired deadline carry grade null and are excluded from event grades.
Statement basis (standalone or consolidated) is not given in the transcripts. Outcomes are graded against reported consolidated figures.
Not graded: the DuPont/Kevlar EXO volume start from Jan 2026 (a third-party product timeline; [unverified]) and the Friedel-Crafts plant commissioning (no dated promise).
